metadata.scope: Astana administrative boundary; OSM inventory plus filtered licensed Overture visitor destinations
metadata.attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors; Overture Maps Foundation and source contributors
metadata.notes: Citywide mapped OSM inventory with filtered licensed Overture visitor destinations, not a census of all physical establishments. Per-source identities, release dates and license notices are retained. Provider existence confidence is not a rating, current-hours check or coordinate-accuracy guarantee. Ambiguous identities and collapsed coordinates are excluded. Unknown hours, ratings, reviews, photos and accessibility stay unknown. No Google, Yandex or 2GIS content is scraped.

media_enrichment.provider: Wikimedia Commons / Wikidata exact entity links
media_enrichment.curation: Source-exact files visually checked; stale construction, people, diagrams and misleading category images excluded.
media_enrichment.policy: Exact linked source identity or accepted multilingual-label/coordinate reconciliation; physical source candidates conservatively deduplicated and filtered; reusable license and plaintext author retained; no nearby or generated venue images
media_enrichment.scope: Discovery staging cohort; publisher recomputes global coverage after deduplication and merge

reviews_enrichment.matching: Exact metadata.osm_id plus location consistency; ES256 signature verified locally; no guessed venue matches

additional_collections.notes: Existence confidence is not a rating, quality measure or current opening status. No source photographs or reviews are implied.

media_discovery.source_matching: Exact source Wikidata identity or exact multilingual label/alias plus P625 distance <=200m; physical P31 whitelist for separate candidate POIs

visual_review.method: Every downloaded thumbnail contact sheet visually inspected; source-exact render, stamp, satellite crop, press portrait, performance-only view and conflicting church image withheld. Normalized Commons titles cannot bypass exclusions.

wikidata_collection.policy: Physical P31 whitelist; exact administrative polygon; new P625 coordinate precision at most 0.001 degrees; immutable QID or exact multilingual alias plus distance; ambiguous similar names quarantined; no public-entry, current-hours, review or accessibility inference

operator_sources.policy: Public operator-page metadata and attributed source links; no unlicensed operator photograph is redistributed

operator_corrections.evidence_validation: Bounded excerpt hashes are verified offline; response hashes identify acquisition evidence and require private raw bodies for full rehashing.

named_operator_collection.policy: Exact separately acquired OSM centre represented for exterior viewing only; official museum-component hours/status stay separate from main aliases/actionable hours and whole-office access; source coordinates agree within 200m; original historical venues preserved

curated_media_expansion.identity_method: Explicit editorial description review bound to exact local source identity; reverse Wikidata OSM IDs for the cathedral; physical-type contradictions rejected; no proximity-only assignment
curated_media_expansion.operator_scope: Alem.ai exterior landmark; museum component hours are separate and do not imply office-centre opening or interior access
